result.description: Lumera Aurora Slate 27Q is a fictional 27-inch curved desktop display built for office dashboards, creative work, and casual media playback. It features a WQHD 2560 x 1440 panel, 75Hz refresh rate, 350 nits typical brightness, and HDMI, DisplayPort, and USB-C connectivity. The monitor includes a matte anti-glare finish, low-blue-light mode, and a height-adjustable stand with tilt support.
